screens.title: Today · 7 outlets
screens.caption: The operations head's view: which workflows ran, which stalled waiting on a person, and the exceptions that need a decision — across every outlet.

screens.title: Workflow · Wastage above limit
screens.caption: A workflow is a chain of detect → ask → wait → escalate, drawn in plain language. The AI does the reading and chasing; people do the deciding.

screens.title: Runs
screens.caption: Every run, step by step: what was detected, who was asked, what they replied, how long it took — the audit trail of the whole operation.

screens.title: Exceptions
screens.caption: Exceptions are the point: the workflow surfaces the few things that genuinely need a person, with the history and a suggested action attached.

screens.title: Approvals
screens.caption: Purchase requests, refunds and vendor payments pass a policy check first, then a named person — on WhatsApp if they are not at a desk.

screens.title: Connections
screens.caption: Workflows read from the systems you already have — POS, Tally, sheets, WhatsApp, phone checklists — and write back to them. Nothing has to be replaced first.

screens.title: Owner digest
screens.caption: The owner reads one message a day. Every line in it came from a workflow — a number, a question, a person and a deadline.
